Game of Thrones fans have officially "Review Bombed" Breaking Bad’s masterpiece ‘Ozymandias,’ dropping its perfect 10/10 to a 9.9 and now it's 9.5. 12 years after it aired. They’re giving it 1-star ratings just to protect their own show’s ranking. When the fifth episode of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms was released, it was rated 10/10, and reportedly Breaking Bad fans downvoted it to 9.7/10 to protect the highest-rated episode crown.

Now, in return, Game of Thrones fans have downvoted the Ozymandias episode of Breaking Bad from 10/10 to 9.5/10. Fans joked that GOT viewers were now returning the favor.

What are your thoughts on this? 💭
